page.overview:
Who is Gantonio?

Gantonio is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates. He serves as a minor antagonist in the Elbaph Arc after being converted into a demon.

Like all giants, Gantonio is a man of exceptional size. He appears bald, with a rounded head shape. He wears a chainmail tunic, a large belt, and a cape over his shoulders.

As a demon, he has the characteristic oni-like teeth protruding from his mouth, horns, glowing eyes, and a pair of bat-shaped wings on his back. He may have also grown in size, given that his crewmates did as well.

According to his captain, Brogy, Gantonio has a tendency to be somewhat greedy, eating far more than his usual share despite assurances to the otherwise. Despite this, he still respects and values the opinion of his leader, apologizing even after he was forcibly transformed into a demon.
